description: Failure → Fix → Re-test ledger. Every test failure encountered during the 2026-07 hardening + MPF migration cycle, with root cause, the fixing commit, and the green re-test evidence. A suite that is only ever green proves nothing; this ledger proves the tests can fail, and that failures get fixed and re-proven — never ignored.

entries.failed: UI audit UI-10: Step-6 Base Vessel line shows a silent $0 at the default Cash Price level (SP560, 'PVC · STANDARD COLOR — $0' while package total was real money)
entries.rootCause: Two layers. (1) The audited $0 was a null activeVariant — material picked but no hull colour clicked; nothing gates Step 6 on a variant and getPriceForLevel(null) returns 0, rendered as $0. (2) Latent resolution bug confirmed by data probe: boat variants carry legacy-polluted priceLevels values (e.g. hull_subdealer: 31, hull_aus_sailing: 30 — percent-off notes, not dollars) which resolvePriceLevel would serve as dollars whenever a level missed the MPF priceLadder. Cash basis must come from sellPriceExclGst (MPF decision D2).
entries.fix: getPriceForLevel: ladder-carrying items never fall through to item.priceLevels — mapped levels use priceLadder exGst, everything else resolves the plain fallback chain starting at sellPriceExclGst. Step-6 Base Vessel line renders an explicit amber marker ('Select hull colour on Step 1' / 'Not priced at this level') instead of a silent $0; subtitle no longer claims 'Standard Color' when no variant is selected.
entries.retest: typecheck 0 + build green; SP560 Firestore probe confirms hull_cash==sellPriceExclGst so selected-variant prices are unchanged; browser spot-check Step 6

entries.failed: Field bug (Asaf's SP560 video): on Step 3, clicking/selecting a motor made the hero carousel show the REDCO TRAILER image instead of the motor
entries.rootCause: (1) Hero image resolution had no fallback CHAIN: resolveImageUrl picked the FIRST populated field (imageUrl -> imageLink -> 'Image Link' -> SummaryImage -> ...) and returned null if that single URL was dead/denylisted -- SP560's Yamaha menu motors carry ONLY SummaryImage (Yamaha CDN .ashx), so any image failure (Incapsula/hotlink) dropped the motor slide entirely via the dead-URL onError path. (2) Slide order is boat -> variant -> build -> motor -> trailer; when the motor slide vanished, embla's reInit kept the current NUMERIC index so the auto-assigned trailer slide shifted into the motor slide's place, and the Step-3 auto-scroll effect bailed on motorIdx === -1, leaving the carousel parked on the trailer brand shot.
entries.fix: New pure module src/lib/hero-carousel.ts: resolveItemImageUrl() walks the FULL candidate chain (imageUrl -> imageLink -> 'Image Link' -> SummaryImage -> url -> image, Yamaha-path normalisation preserved) returning the first RENDERABLE url (dead-set/SharePoint denylist injected); findSelectionScrollIndex() returns the desired slide type's index when it exists, else falls back variant -> boat (hull imagery) and returns -1 (no scroll) when no safe slide exists -- NEVER an unrelated type. highfield-quote-flow.tsx: resolveImageUrl delegates to the lib; Step-3 motor effect and Step-4 trailer effect both scroll via findSelectionScrollIndex (same function re-runs on embla reInit, so a mid-view image death that drops a slide self-corrects onto hull imagery instead of the shifted trailer).
entries.retest: New harness tests/unit/hero-carousel.test.ts (15 tests: dead-imageUrl-but-good-SummaryImage fallback, SharePoint-denylist skip-and-continue, Yamaha CDN prefixing, SP560 regression layout [boat,variant,trailer,gallery] + desired 'motor' -> variant index NOT trailer, -1 when no safe slide, trailer symmetry, exhaustive never-unrelated sweep) ALL PASS; full unit suite 551/551; typecheck 0; prod build green. entries.failed: Invariants audit I5 (financial-invariants hunter, 2026-07-04): on twin-capable hulls with both motorEnvelope bounds set (e.g. Stabicraft 2350, envelope 225-350 total HP, curated twin F150s), the Step-5 curation rule R-HP hid every dealer-fit item named for the per-engine motor ('Cowl Cover to suit F150' parsed as [150,150], tested against the TOTAL-HP envelope 225-350, no overlap -> hidden)
entries.rootCause: MPF Min/Max HP columns are TOTAL installed HP (source-verified: twin-F150 boats carry min 225 / max 350) while dealer-fit item names carry PER-ENGINE HP. R-HP compared the per-engine item interval directly against the total envelope with no engine-count scaling. Same semantic slip produced 49 false alarms in the audit itself (fixed there too). NSM Recommended motor menus were never affected -- they render unfiltered.
entries.fix: CurationContext gains maxEngines (derived in highfield-quote-flow.tsx from motorEnvelope.shaft 'Twin/Triple/Quad' wording or motorConfigurations[0].type); R-HP tests each parsed HP interval scaled by every plausible engine count k=1..maxEngines and stays fail-open.
